g.text: Stationary cues · spatial activity builds a complex vector
Each contribution is active concentration × physical segment length × outward normal; opposite contributions can cancel. M₀ = ΣuⱼΔsⱼ.
Four actual conditions from the same 80-case experiment · cue fixed in place, then 13,000 cue-free native units · native amplitudes and clocks differ
P planes have equal real/imaginary scales and a unit-circle reference. Shaded R<.1 disk: heading is not interpreted. Profile shading: initial cue footprint.
